summary: Staggered offboarding and phased device/account handback for sabbatical-overlap engineer
description:
Issue summary:
A senior ML engineer (internal ID ENG-5742) is going on a planned sabbatical starting 2026-03-20 for 6 months. They will be partially handing off an in-use GPU laptop (serial GLP-3319) to a contractor and retaining a lightweight loaner for occasional check-ins. HR requested a staggered deprovisioning window to preserve access required for an orderly handover while ensuring credentials and keys are rotated promptly after transfer.

Impact:
- Risk of lingering privileged access if accounts or service tokens are not rotated during the handoff.
- Potential interruption to ongoing model training jobs if device provisioning is changed without coordination.
- Compliance note: must meet standard KMS/HSM key-handling policy and asset chain-of-custody for internal audits.

Environment:
- Internal identity provider: Okta (SSO + SCIM)
- Device management: Jamf for macOS fleet, Intune for loaners integration
- KMS: AWS KMS (customer-managed key alias redwood/sandbox)
- Affected team: Applied ML (us-west region for compute)

Required actions (staged):
1) Prior to 2026-03-18: Create a short-lived contractor service account 'contractor-eng-5742-temp' with scoped groups: 'ml-training-readonly', 'gpu-lab-join'. Add MFA enforced and set expiry 2026-09-20.
2) 2026-03-19: Begin device handoff. Engineer transfers GPU laptop (GLP-3319) physically to contractor. Jamf record to be updated to contractor user.
3) 2026-03-19 to 2026-03-22: Rotate service account keys, revoke any long-lived tokens tied to ENG-5742. Audit KMS access for key aliases referenced in /projects/rl-inference-training.
4) 2026-03-23: Disable ENG-5742 provisioning for non-essential groups (remove 'admin-ml', 'sre-debug'), keep 'read-only-collab' for 30-day overlap.
5) 2026-04-20: Complete deprovision: revoke remaining groups, reassign corporate repos, confirm asset transfer in inventory.

Acceptance criteria:
- Contractor temp account has access only to scoped resources and auto-expires on 2026-09-20.
- No active long-lived tokens or SSH keys remain associated with ENG-5742.
- Jamf/asset DB shows GLP-3319 assigned to contractor with signed handoff note.
- KMS access logs show explicit rotation event and removed principals within the KMS policy.

Notes on constraints:
- The engineer runs a multi-day checkpointed experiment; we cannot shut down their training VM before 2026-03-19. We must coordinate with infra to avoid killing jobs when rotating keys.
- Contracting team requires hardware to start 2026-03-20 for onboarding tasks.

Risk mitigation:
- Use temporary bastion credentials to allow contractor to SSH to a staging cluster node for onboarding instead of direct access to engineer's instance.
- Schedule a short network maintenance window (15 minutes) for key rotation to minimize impact on in-progress training checkpoints.

Owner and communication plan:
- Primary owner: Maya Ortiz (SRE ops)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Avery Chen: Raised task after HR sabbatical notice. Requested phased deprovision to avoid disrupting live experiment.
2026-03-10 13:47 - Maya Ortiz: Assigned to SRE ops. Will coordinate with Applied ML and infra to identify active jobs and determine safe rotation window.

2026-03-11 08:31 - Priya Rao (Applied ML): Confirmed long-running checkpointed job exists on training-cluster-6 until 2026-03-19 04:00 UTC. We can snapshot and drain nodes during the proposed 03/19 rotation window.
2026-03-11 16:04 - SRE oncall (Jon Park): Tentative maintenance window 2026-03-19 03:00-03:30 UTC reserved. Will prepare rollback playbook if checkpoint restore fails.

2026-03-12 10:15 - Maya Ortiz: Created contractor account template 'contractor-eng-temp' and documented required group membership in Confluence. PR created for Jamf device owner change (see related PR).
investigation_notes: Checked Okta SCIM logs: ENG-5742 has 3 active SSH keys attached to service accounts created in 2025-11; keys flagged for rotation.
Audit KMS logs: principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:user/ENG-5742 used kms:Decrypt on 2026-02-20. Need to remove principal from policies and ensure alias redirection.
Jamf inventory shows GLP-3319 assigned to ENG-5742 and last check-in 2026-03-08; confirm full disk encryption present and recovery key escrowed to corporate KMS.
resolution: Staggered deprovision plan executed. Contractor account created with expiry and scoped groups. Jamf reassignment scheduled for 2026-03-19 after successful checkpoint snapshot. All long-lived tokens and SSH keys were revoked during the rotation window; KMS key policies updated to remove ENG-5742. Follow-up: confirm signed asset handoff and close ticket after 2026-04-20 final deprovision.
acceptance_criteria_checklist: Jamf shows GLP-3319 assigned to contractor with handoff note
KMS policy updated and rotation recorded
